function.name: read_site_memory
function.description: Read site-owned Markdown memory. Start with index.md in a new conversation, then read only notes relevant to the user's task. Missing memory is normal; failed reads are not absence. offset/nextOffset are character offsets. sha256 is a persisted content receipt, not implementation evidence. Do not copy Topics, Milestones or planning into memory.

path.description: ASCII Markdown filename, default index.md. Basename: 1-80 English letters/digits/underscores/hyphens, starting with a letter or digit; followed by lowercase .md. No Chinese, spaces, directories or extra dots. Use index.md exactly in lowercase; other names must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,79}\.md$.

offset.description: Zero-based character offset, from 0 to 2147483647. Default 0. Use nextOffset from the previous read to continue.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters to read. Positive integer, default 4000, maximum 8000 per page. Larger values are capped at 8000. Use nextOffset from the result to read the next page.
